anomaly_image_f1_max — SPC anomaly_eval op

• データ種: signal × signal → table

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.anomaly_image_f1_max(scores, labels) (実装を直接呼ぶなら import anomeval; anomeval.anomaly_image_f1_max(scores, labels)、台帳から引くなら opsspc.get("anomaly_image_f1_max"))

• GPU: なし(CPU 参照実装のみ)

使い方

Best image-level F1 over all thresholds from one anomaly score per image and a good/defective label (table).

scores is a 1-D array (higher = more anomalous), labels the same length with 1 / True = defective; an image is predicted defective when its score is >= the threshold. Exact at every distinct score; the highest threshold wins a tie. Returns f1, threshold, precision, recall, n_pos and n_neg (images).

Raises ValueError on empty / mismatched / non-finite input, non-binary labels, or when all images carry the same label.
